query: 举报人保护机制 举报人保护机制 衡量企业是否建立并披露了制度化、可操作的举报渠道，以及对举报人实施保密、保护和禁止报复的正式机制。 2分：企业同时满足以下三项标准。第一，披露了具体的举报渠道。第二，明确承诺对举报人身份保密或允许匿名举报。第三，制定了禁止对举报人实施报复的政策或声明。 1分：企业满足上述2分标准中的任意一项或两项。或者，企业虽提及设有举报机制，但缺乏具体渠道描述、保密承诺或保护政策的任一项内容。 0分：企业在ESG报告、企业管治报告及公司官网中均未披露任何举报机制相关信息。或者，仅以“本公司设有举报制度”等笼统表述一笔带过，无任何可验证的具体内容。 举报人保护 举报机制 吹哨人 举报热线 匿名举报 保密举报 禁止报复 反舞弊举报 诉说政策 whistleblowing whistleblower protection speak-up reporting hotline anonymous reporting confidential reporting non-retaliation anti-fraud reporting 披露了哪些具体举报渠道（热线、邮箱、平台）？ 是否允许匿名或承诺保密？ 是否有禁止报复政策？ 可举报事项范围是什么？ 受理与反馈流程如何运作？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '举报人保护机制'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 披露了哪些具体举报渠道（热线、邮箱、平台）？ 是否允许匿名或承诺保密？ 是否有禁止报复政策？ 可举报事项范围是什么？ 受理与反馈流程如何运作？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“设有举报制度”无渠道；仅有员工申诉意见箱且无反舞弊定位；仅有客户投诉；仅有反腐政策而无举报机制细节；区分：举报人保护强调舞弊/合规举报渠道与反报复；员工申诉偏劳动权益；供应商申诉面向供应商；反贿赂政策是实体规范，不等于已建立可操作举报保护。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: GOVERNANCE & OPERATIONAL RESPONSIBILITY / Code of Ethics and Business Conduct
results.text: In order to create a fair, impartial and clean working atmosphere and operating environment, Impro Group has formulated the Internal Reporting Management System of Impro Group, Employee Code of Conduct, Anti-Commercial Bribery Undertaking and other documents, set up diversified reporting channels for corruption incidents, improved reporting and investigation procedures and corruption incident monitoring procedures, and regularly carries out special audit and anti-corruption training. During the Reporting Period, we set up a new column of 'Integrity Culture' in the Group's i nternal network to encourage employees to actively participate in the integrity building of the Group.

[Content]
In order to create a fair, impartial and clean working atmosphere and operating environment, Impro Group has formulated the Internal Reporting Management System of Impro Group, Employee Code of Conduct, Anti-Commercial Bribery Undertaking and other documents, set up diversified reporting channels for corruption incidents, improved reporting and investigation procedures and corruption incident monitoring procedures, and regularly carries out special audit and anti-corruption training. During the Reporting Period, we set up a new column of 'Integrity Culture' in the Group's i nternal network to encourage employees to actively participate in the integrity building of the Group.

results.section: GOVERNANCE & OPERATIONAL RESPONSIBILITY / The Reward System for Whistleblower
results.text: The Group strictly complies with the requirements of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Product Quality, the Standardization Law of the People's Republic of China and other laws, regulations and regulatory policies, and has been improving internal quality management processes and systems. During the Reporting Period, we updated the Management Regulations on Advanced Product Quality Planning, the Management Regulations on Equipment and Facilities and other management policies, and strictly controlled product quality with a responsible attitude towards products and customers. Impro Group is committed to continuous improvement and customer success, empowering customers with quality products, promoting sustainable growth of its own business, and assisting customers in sustainable development.
results.retrieval_text:

GOVERNANCE & OPERATIONAL RESPONSIBILITY / The Reward System for Whistleblower

[Content]
The Group strictly complies with the requirements of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Product Quality, the Standardization Law of the People's Republic of China and other laws, regulations and regulatory policies, and has been improving internal quality management processes and systems. During the Reporting Period, we updated the Management Regulations on Advanced Product Quality Planning, the Management Regulations on Equipment and Facilities and other management policies, and strictly controlled product quality with a responsible attitude towards products and customers. Impro Group is committed to continuous improvement and customer success, empowering customers with quality products, promoting sustainable growth of its own business, and assisting customers in sustainable development.
